subject: Clarifying decision drivers: latency targets, deployment mode, procurement timeline
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@mediacorp.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@mediacorp.com>
Cc: procurement@mediacorp.com
Date: 2027-09-01T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo follow-up — decision drivers and next steps

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for taking the demo today. I wanted to capture the few open items we discussed and confirm next steps so we keep momentum toward a procurement decision. High-level recap below, with a couple of specific asks.

Key decision drivers we heard on the call:
- Latency: target p95 for inference <= 200ms for ~256-token prompts (primary KPI).
- Deployment: prefer Dedicated or Private (VPC) for initial rollout — data residency + predictable throughput are important.
- Security/compliance: SOC 2 + network diagrams + audit log retention policy required for vendor review.
- Economics: total cost of ownership and per-token unit economics will drive the final approval — procurement wants a ballpark for sizing.

Asks / open items:
1) Please confirm the internal economic buyer and the procurement timeline (weeks to contract).
2) Confirm the security contact who will lead the questionnaire and whether an NDA is in place.
3) Any hard constraints on deployment (blocked on on-prem only, or is VPC acceptable?).
4) If you can share a rough QPS/peak tokens estimate (or expected concurrent users), we’ll model a pricing/throughput proposal.

I’ve attached a one-pager on our SLA/typical latency profiles and a short procurement questions spreadsheet — will help speed the legal/procurement review.

Proposed next steps:
- You share procurement contact + econ buyer (this week)
- We route technical follow-up: infra + security deep-dive next week
- Redwood provides a preliminary pricing/throughput estimate within 3 business days after we get concurrent usage numbers

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick sync if that helps.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0197

Attachments:
- redwood-quick-sla-one-pager.pdf (pdf)
- mediacorp-procurement-questions.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@mediacorp.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@mediacorp.com>, procurement@mediacorp.com
Date: 2027-09-01T17:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo follow-up — decision drivers and next steps

Thanks Lauren — great demo. Quick answers inline: 

- Economic buyer: Priya Shah (Head of AI Programs, Priya Shah <priya.shah@mediacorp.com>). She will own budget approvals.
- Procurement timeline: target 6–8 weeks if we can get SOC2 evidence + pricing within the next week.
- Latency target: yes, p95 <= 200ms for 256-token prompts is the goal. We can tolerate higher p50 but p95 is gated.
- Deployment preference: preferred Dedicated pool (reserved GPU capacity) but VPC Private deployment is acceptable if SLA/perf parity is demonstrated. On-prem is a hard no for this project.
- Security: our security lead is James Hollis (james.hollis@mediacorp.com). He asked for SOC2 Type II report, network topology, and a brief on logging/audit retention.
- Sizing: rough estimate — pilot: 10–20 qps peak, ~1.5M tokens/month; production (Q1 next year) could be 75–120 qps, ~15–20M tokens/month.

Procurement contact: procurement@mediacorp.com (you can loop them into contract questions).

We’ll set up a security call next week; I’ll let James propose times. Also Priya, looping you in here to confirm budget window and any preferred procurement forms.

—Alex
Alex Gomez
Product Manager, MediaCorp AI

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@mediacorp.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@mediacorp.com>, procurement@mediacorp.com
Date: 2027-09-02T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Post-demo follow-up — decision drivers and next steps (tech + pricing asks)

Team — looping you both in to align on feasibility and a response we can send back to MediaCorp. Summary from Alex below: 200ms p95 target (256 tokens), Dedicated preferred, pilot sizing ~10–20 qps, production ~75–120 qps. Security lead is James Hollis.

Karthik — can you run a quick readiness check: given the target 200ms p95 at 256 tokens, on Dedicated GPU pool what model/quantization profile would you propose to hit that at pilot and prod sizing? Please include an estimate for required GPUs and any autoscale strategy recommendations. If there’s a trade-off we should call out (e.g., quantization increases latency variance), note it.

Vivek — James will ask for SOC2 evidence, network topology, and audit/log retention. I’ve attached the procurement questions they requested. Can you draft the short security one-pager (SOC2 summary + logging retention + IP/data handling bullets) we can share with James? Also confirm whether we can allow VPC private deployment with equivalent SLAs to Dedicated.

Action items / timeline: 
- Karthik: model/throughput + GPU estimate and a short notes doc (48 hours)
- Vivek: security one-pager + confirmation re: VPC parity (48 hours)
- Lauren: I’ll prepare a pricing ballpark (pilot vs prod) once we have the GPU estimate; send to Alex/Priya within 72 hours of their sizing confirmation.

Alex / Priya — we’ll send a short joint note with pricing and the technical assumptions once internal folks validate. Would you prefer a single combined doc or separate technical + commercial attachments for procurement?

Thanks — appreciate the fast turnaround.

Regards,
Lauren
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com

Date: 2027-09-03T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo follow-up — decision drivers and next steps

Hi Lauren / Alex —

Thanks for the clear recap. A few quick clarifications from procurement/budget side: 
- Timeline: 6–8 weeks is fine from our side if we get SOC2 + pricing this week.
- Budget owner: I will own the approval; the ask will go through corporate procurement for final sign-off.
- Price expectation: Can you provide a ballpark monthly cost for the pilot (10–20 qps) and a separate estimate for production sizing (75–120 qps)? We don’t need exact numbers yet, just a realistic range for internal gating.
- SOW/contract: procurement will prefer an order form + SOW model. Please include any migration/engagement fees separately.

Also James — please coordinate with Lauren/Vivek on the security checklist. I’m good with either a combined commercial + tech pack or separate docs; procurement likes separate attachments (technical evidence + commercial proposal).

If you can get the pricing ballpark and the security one-pager over by EOD Thursday, I’ll push this through the initial approval queue.

Thanks,
Priya Shah
Head of AI Programs, MediaCorp
priya.shah@mediacorp.com
